model: iid geometric occupancies of integer mean mu
exactness: The probability numerator and denominator are exact integer values from Fraction arithmetic. Decimal columns are deterministic presentations only.
theorem_check: For every nondeep reset message -mu<M<=2mu, X in [2mu+2-M,4mu-M] forces the exact TreeStack output into [mu,2mu]. The worst message is M=-mu+1.
interpretation: The worst one-step regeneration probability is already about 0.043 at these means and is uniformly at least 8/(17 e^3) for mu>=16. This constant cost creates no linear-in-L exponent penalty.
